subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should gateway history preserve numeric `nextCursor` responses for existing clients while adding opaque generation-aware paging through a versioned or opt-in contract?
rationale: The performance implementation is well evidenced, but choosing whether the public history cursor may change shape is an API compatibility decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Version the opaque cursor contract
options.body: Retain numeric `nextCursor` behavior for legacy requests and expose the opaque cursor only through an explicit version or capability path with upgrade tests.

options.title: Accept the breaking response change
options.body: Document and intentionally ship opaque `nextCursor` values after confirming that the gateway HTTP response is not a supported compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Version the opaque cursor contract
recommendation.body: Retain numeric `nextCursor` behavior for legacy requests and expose the opaque cursor only through an explicit version or capability path with upgrade tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged bounded-history foundation and its gateway-facing compatibility implications make this contributor the strongest available routing candidate.
